Based on `docs/reference/status-and-configuration/live-agent.md`, there isn't really a flag that "makes" a session write-enabled — writes are the default. The page's Session Flags table (and the Invocation table) lists `--allow-write` as a "Compatibility flag. Writes are already the default. Do not combine it with `--read-only`." So `--allow-write` is the flag you'd pass if you wanted to be explicit about write mode, but per the page it doesn't turn anything on that isn't already on.

The page frames the actual control the other way: `--read-only` is what disables writes. It says `--read-only` will "Disable documentation edits, workflow writes, and host commands" and, further down, "`--read-only` disables file writes and host commands for that session." The "Edit Files and Run Commands" section confirms "Direct checkout edits and write workflows are enabled by default," so a session is write-enabled unless you pass `--read-only`.
